gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-martel-sans: Jelly Crazies pours its letters out in one fat, wobbly width with bowls nearly sealed, while Martel Sans stays light and open. The gap between them is the draw.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-matangi: Blobby, nearly sealed bowls give Jelly Crazies its goofy, poured-ink look. Matangi sits beneath it like pressed twine, its rounded letters left open and its lowercase hefty.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-maven-pro: Jelly Crazies wobbles with nearly sealed bowls and no thinning. Maven Pro, a sans with a welcoming gap in its c and a high-waisted lowercase, gives the pair its strongest quality: closed shapes against open ones.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-michroma: A single-depth engraver's cut gives Jelly Crazies its odd, wobbly stamp. Michroma gives each letter a wide berth on both sides, so the pair's strongest quality is tight, closed heading shapes set against spacious, tall-bodied plain sans text.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-miriam-libre: Wobbly and nearly sealed, Jelly Crazies bounces along with no calligraphic thinning at all. And Miriam Libre answers in drawn-wire strokes, its sans lowercase standing tall like cast iron capitals, so a larger heading size would let the heading's bounce stand out.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-mochiy-pop-o: Mochiy Pop One brings a very large lowercase eye and letters hung like clothespins on a line, under the wobbly Jelly Crazies. Text would move along steadily.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-mochiy-pop-p: Mochiy Pop P One reads clean and approachable, with a wide stretch of blank space between each sizable letter. Jelly Crazies, wobbly and nearly sealed, can take a noticeably bigger size than that body text.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-montserrat-u: Playful and wobbly, Jelly Crazies closes its bowls up tight. Montserrat Underline answers with breathing counters and an oversized lowercase in a plain sans, so the heading's poured shapes get a spacious partner.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-mozilla-head: Playful through and through, Jelly Crazies wobbles along with nearly sealed bowls and no calligraphic thinning. Mozilla Headline's big-bodied lowercase and splayed c terminals open everything back up.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-mozilla-text: Jelly Crazies wobbles at a leisurely walk, its bowls nearly sealed shut and its strokes never thinning. Mozilla Text, a sans-serif with tall bodies and flaring terminals, would read briskly and confidently over many lines.
